age-line.effect: The Age Line was a charm used to create a sort of barrier that prevented people below a specified age, or above a specified age, depending on the intention, from accessing a specific object or place.
age-line.effectFr: Une fine ligne dorée au sol qui bloque quiconque la dépasse s'il est trop jeune (elle peut probablement être réglée pour bloquer le passage des gens plus vieux qu'un âge donné ).

alarte-ascendare.effect: Alarte Ascendare was the incantation of a charm used to launch an object up into the air.

albus-dumbledore-s-forceful-spell.effect: This spell was used by Dumbledore in the British Ministry of Magic during the Battle of the Department of Mysteries on 18 June 1996, when he was duelling Lord Voldemort.

alohomora-duo.effect: Alohomora Duo was the incantation of a stronger variation of the Unlocking Charm, a spell which unlocked doors and other locked objects, but was unclear in how it was stronger.

altering-spell.effect: The Altering Spell was a Transfiguration spell used to transform the physical form or colour of objects.

amplificus.effect: Amplificus was the incantation for a spell. Its exact effect was unknown, but it didn't amplify sound.

amplifying-charm.effect: The Amplifying Charm (Sonorus) was a charm that could be used to amplify the targeted sound, be it a person's voice or a piece of equipment. The counter-charm to this spell was the Quietening Charm.
amplifying-charm.effectFr: Permet à la voix de porter sur une grande distance.

anapneo.effect: Anapneo was the incantation of a healing spell and charm that cleared the target's airway by vanishing whatever the target was choking on.
anapneo.effectFr: Sortilège qui libère la trachée de la cible si elle est bloquée.

animagus-spell.effect: The Animagus Spell (Amato Animo Animato Animagus) was a transfiguration spell used in the process of becoming an Animagus.

animation-charm.effect: The Animation Charm (Piertotum Locomotor) was a charm used to bring life to those artefacts that had, previously, been inanimate and unmoving. The target's movements could be controlled by the caster of the charm. It was one of the favourite spells of Professor Minerva McGonagall, along with Endless Sandwiches and the Bird-Conjuring Charm. The use of this spell on a skeleton was one of the two ways to create a charmed skeleton, with the only other way being through necromancy. Only a charmed skeleton created through necromancy would be considered Dark magic, despite the result being near-identical.

anteoculatia.effect: Anteoculatia was the incantation of a dark charm that grew antlers on the head of the target.

anti-apparition-charm.effect: The Anti-Apparition Charm, also known as the Anti-Apparition Jinx, was a jinx that prevented people from Apparating into an area. It was cast on the entire castle and grounds of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry long ago, and could only be lifted by the Headmaster of the time.

anti-cheating-spell.effect: The Anti-Cheating Spell, also known as the Anti-Cheating Charm, was a charm that prevented a person from cheating on a test or exam.
anti-cheating-spell.effectFr: Appliqués sur les plumes avant les examens.

anti-disapparition-jinx.effect: The Anti-Disapparition Jinx was used to prevent Disapparition in an area. Presumably, it could be used to aid in trapping a victim within an area. It could also be used to protect an area or to trap prey.

anti-intruder-jinx.effect: The anti-intruder jinx (incantation unknown) was a jinx placed in an environment to prevent intruders from entering an area. It was placed on Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 1996 for extra protection during an invasion by Death Eaters.

antonin-dolohov-s-curse.effect: This curse (incantation unknown) was used by the Death Eater Antonin Dolohov during the Battle of the Department of Mysteries in 1996. The curse was cast using "a sudden slashing movement with the wand", causing a streak of purple flame to strike the target. This curse caused major injuries, and if performed with enough power, had the capacity to kill.

apparition.effect: Apparition was a form of magical transportation in which the user travelled instantly from one location to another without traversing the space in-between. This was accomplished by having the user focus on a desired location in their mind and then purposely disappearing from where they were to reappear at the desired location. Apparition was by far the fastest and most convenient way to get to a desired destination, but was tricky to pull off correctly and disastrous if botched. The ability to Apparate was a relatively advanced skill for wizards, but other magical creatures were capable of disappearing and reappearing of their own volition as well, such as house-elves, Phoenixes, Diricawls, and Zouwus.
apparition.effectFr: "Apparaître", "Disparaître" ["Apparate, Disapparate"] ou "Transplaner", ce qui englobe les deux (en français uniquement)

aqua-eructo.effect: Aqua Eructo was the incantation of a charm that could be used to create a spout of water from the tip of the wand. The intensity of the water flow could be anything from a thin fountain to an immense and powerful jet.

aquarius-scarius.effect: Aquarius Scarius was the incantation for a charm. Its exact effect was unknown.

arrow-shooting-spell.effect: The Arrow Shooting Spell was a transfiguration spell which conjured shooting arrows from the caster's wand.

ascendio.effect: The Ascension Charm (Ascendio) was a charm which flung the caster high into the air. The charm also worked underwater, propelling the caster above the surface.

atmospheric-charm.effect: The Atmospheric Charm, or Atmosphere Charm , was a type of Weather-Modifying Charm, which was used to create certain weather condition indoors. It could be removed with meteolojinx recanto.

avenseguim.effect: Avenseguim was the incantation of a charm that turned a target object into a tracking device.

avifors-spell.effect: The Avifors Spell (Avifors) was a transfiguration spell that transformed small objects and creatures into birds. The spell was viewed as a jinx when used to transform certain creatures into birds.

babbling-curse.effect: The Babbling Curse was a curse that caused uncontrollable babbling.
babbling-curse.effectFr: Effet exact mal connu ; on suppose qu'il fait babiller la victime.

badgering.effect: Badgering , was a transfiguration spell that turned a target into a badger.

bandaging-charm.effect: The Bandaging Charm (Ferula), was a healing charm which conjured bandages and wrapped them around a wound, splinting any broken bones. The bandaging also appeared to ease pain.
bandaging-charm.effectFr: Sort qui fait apparaître une attelle.

banishing-charm.effect: The Banishing Charm (Depulso) was a charm that sent the target away from the caster. It could send a target towards a specific location and worked on both living beings and inanimate objects. The Banishing Charm was the opposite of the Summoning Charm. Unlike the Summoning Charm, which could summon specific objects from anywhere, the Banishing Charm only banished whatever the wand was aimed at.

basic-cast.effect: The Basic Cast was a spell that shot red sparks out of the caster's wand and caused damage or harm to targets. The spell was prominently used in duelling and warding off attacking creatures.

bat-bogey-hex.effect: The Bat-Bogey Hex was a hex that transformed the target's bogeys into large bats that flew out of the victim's nose. The spell was invented by Miranda Goshawk. The use of the Bat-Bogey Hex on a non-human target (such as a chicken) could be fatal, and may have resulted in punishment by the Wizengamot. It was also Ginevra Weasley's signature spell.
bat-bogey-hex.effectFr: Fait se couvrir le visage de la victime de sortes de chauve-souris qui battent des ailes en tous sens.

baubillious.effect: Baubillious was the incantation of a charm that precipitated a jet of white sparks from the tip of the wand. It could be used as an offensive duelling spell. During the 1990–1991 school year, Ismelda Murk claimed that Barnaby Lee was trying to use mnemonics to memorise this spell by associating the word 'Butterbeer' with this spell's incantation.

bedazzling-hex.effect: The Bedazzling Hex was a hex which was used to disguise things, effectively making them invisible. It could be cast on a cloak to turn it into an Invisibility Cloak, though, like most Invisibility Cloaks, the effectiveness would wear off over time.

bewitched-snowballs.effect: Bewitched Snowballs was a charm that could bewitch snowballs so that they hone in on a designated target and continually plague them by throwing themselves at said target.

bird-conjuring-charm.effect: The Bird-Conjuring Charm (Avis) was a charm that conjured a flock of birds. Out of all of the spells used to conjure living things, The Bird-Conjuring Charm was the among the easiest, alongside the Snake Summons Spell. It was one of the favourite spells of Professor Minerva McGonagall, along with Endless Sandwiches and the Animation Charm. The birds were shot from the caster's wand tip, accompanied by a loud blast that sounded like a gun being fired and smoke.
bird-conjuring-charm.effectFr: Fait apparaître une volée de petits oiseaux gazouillants.

blasting-curse.effect: The Blasting Curse (Confringo) was a curse that caused the target to explode. This curse could incapacitate, as well as injure, and in some cases, kill, so it was popular when it came to duelling. It could also be used to destroy objects and fight back against animals. However, it wasn't always the most precise spell and for that reason could result in unintended consequences.
blasting-curse.effectFr: Sort utile pour les duels de Sorciers.

bloomus.effect: Bloomus was the incantation for a charm related to Herbology. Its exact effects were unknown, but it didn't make the plant grow faster.

bluebell-flames.effect: Bluebell Flames , also known as Cold Fire, was a charm that created magical blue flames with unique properties.
bluebell-flames.effectFr: Fait jaillir une quantité de flammes bleues que l'on peut diriger à un endroit précis.

blue-sparks.effect: Blue Sparks was a charm that precipitated a jet of blue sparks from the tip of the wand. It could also be used offensively as a minor duelling spell. When such blue sparks were produced in large quantities, it was difficult to see or breathe when in the vicinity.

boggart-banishing-spell.effect: The Boggart-Banishing Spell (Riddikulus) was a charm that was used to defeat a Boggart. It caused the creature to assume a form that was humorous to the caster, along with a whip-crack noise, thereby taking away the Boggart's ability to terrorise. Boggarts were defeated by laughter, so forcing them to assume an amusing form was the first step to defeating them. However, as the Boggart was amortal, the spell merely "banished" them, not destroyed.
boggart-banishing-spell.effectFr: Protection contre un Epouvantard. Oblige la créature à prendre une apparence ridicule.

bombarda-maxima.effect: Bombarda Maxima was the incantation used for the strongest variation of the Bombardment Spell. It provoked large, violent explosions capable of demolishing entire walls.

bombardment-spell.effect: The Bombardment Spell, or the Exploding Charm (Bombarda), was a charm that detonated the target in a small explosion. One use for this explosion was to blast open sealed doors or to blow bars off of windows. However, it was noisy, and therefore not recommended for those who wished to avoid detection, and the explosions caused by this spell gave off a harsh light which could cause eye damage, though this could be mitigated by wearing Blue Solar Protection Goggles. The incantation Bombarda Maxima was the strongest variation of this spell.

bouquet-spell.effect: The Bouquet Spell (Orchideous) was a transfiguration spell that conjured a bouquet of flowers from the tip of the caster's wand. The spell was invented by Miranda Goshawk. The movement for this spell was to move one's wand in a circle in the air, with the spell producing a pink light upon casting. The spell could produce a bouquet of any flowers, based on the wishes of the caster. This spell was covered in fourth-year Transfiguration classes at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, with the spell often being reviewed close to Valentine's Day.
bouquet-spell.effectFr: Fait apparaître un bouquet de fleurs au bout de la baguette.

box-blasting-charm.effect: The Box Blasting Charm (Cistem Aperio) was a charm that was used to blast open trunks, chests, boxes, or other containers.

brackium-emendo.effect: Brackium Emendo was the incantation of a healing spell that that could supposedly be used to mend broken bones, but also possibly remove them. It was unknown if this particular spell was a legitimate healing spell or just a variation of one.

bravery-charm.effect: The Bravery Charm was a charm that enhanced the performance of teammates when they were facing certain foes.

bridge-conjuring-spell.effect: This transfiguration spell was used to conjure and create a bridge out of thin air. This spell was used by Ignotus, Antioch and Cadmus Peverell in The Tale of the Three Brothers to create a bridge over a treacherous river allowing them all to walk across safely, a bridge upon which they met Death.

broom-jinx.effect: This jinx was used to make broomsticks try to throw their riders off through a variety of means such as sudden lurches and violent swishing movements.

bubble-head-charm.effect: The Bubble-Head Charm was a charm that produced a bubble around the head of the caster, giving them a continuous supply of oxygen, allowing them to breathe where they could not otherwise. It was the most effective spell for breathing underwater or in any environment where fresh air is at a premium, allowing one a supply of oxygen.
bubble-head-charm.effectFr: Enferme la tête de l'auteur du sort dans une bulle d'air.

bubble-spell.effect: The Bubble Spell was used to conjure a stream of bubbles from the tip of the wand.

cascading-jinx.effect: The Cascading Jinx is a jinx used to attacking multiple opponents in close proximity to each other. When cast, the spell erupts into an explosion, hitting everything within the range set by the caster.

caterwauling-charm.effect: The Caterwauling Charm was a charm that caused any unauthorised person entering the perimeter of a certain area to set off an "alarm" which made a high-pitched scream.

cauldron-to-badger-spell.effect: This spell transformed a cauldron into a badger. It was taught at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry sometime during or before the fifth year in Transfiguration. Harry Potter practised this spell for his Ordinary Wizarding Levels during the 1995–1996 school year.

cauldron-to-sieve.effect: Cauldron to Sieve was a transforming spell that transfigured cauldrons into sieves.

cave-inimicum.effect: Cave inimicum was the incantation of a protective charm that produced a boundary that kept the caster hidden from view. Those who were on the other side of the shield were not be able to see, hear, or (if the spell was well cast) smell them.

cheering-charm.effect: The Cheering Charm was a charm that made the target feel elated. When the charm was overdone, it could have caused the victim to be overcome with fits of hysterical laughter. The Cheering Charm may have been connected to the counter-charm for hiccoughs in some manner.
cheering-charm.effectFr: Donne une durable sensation de contentement, rend heureux.

circumrota.effect: Circumrota was the incantation of a charm that could be used to turn or rotate objects.

cleaning-charm.effect: The Cleaning Charm was a cleaning spell used to clean the target. The W.O.M.B.A.T test mentioned this charm in the question of which breach of the International Statute of Wizarding Secrecy should receive the lightest punishment.

colour-change-charm.effect: The Colour Change Charm (Colovaria), also known as the Colour-Changing Charm, was a charm that changed the colour of the target. Its incantation was similar to that of the Growth Charm.

combat-bolt.effect: Combat Bolt was a standard offensive spell that was used in magical combat to attack the target and harm it. This spell was heavily used by members of the Statute of Secrecy Task Force in the 21st century against various foes they fought whilst battling the Calamity.

concealment-charm.effect: Concealment Charms were charms used to conceal things from view and to obfuscate inherent magical properties of objects.

confundus-charm.effect: The Confundus Charm (Confundo) was a charm which confused and misdirected the target. It worked on living and inanimate things, as long as the target had a mind to be confused. There were varying degrees of confusion that could be caused by the spell, ranging from becoming unaware of the current situation, forgetting important information, or becoming particularly impressionable.

confusion-hex.effect: The Confusion Hex was a hex which impaired foes by weakening their mental awareness, making them more vulnerable to attack.

conjunctivitis-curse.effect: The Conjunctivitis Curse was a curse that irritated the target's eyes, forcing them to swell shut. Dragons were notably susceptible to this curse, because while their hide made them resistant to most spells, their eyes remained vulnerable. The Oculus Potion was able to counteract this curse. A variation of this curse existed which was purple in colour that completely blinded the target, which could also not be counteracted with the Oculus Potion.

cornflake-skin-spell.effect: The Cornflake Skin Jinx was a Dark charm that caused the target's skin to look as though it was coated in cornflakes.

cracker-jinx.effect: The Cracker Jinx was a jinx that conjured exploding Wizard Crackers. This jinx could be used in duelling to harm the opponent, but the force of the explosion might also affect the caster.

cribbing-spell.effect: A Cribbing Spell was a charm that assisted the caster in cheating on written papers, tests and exams.

crinus-muto.effect: Crinus Muto was the incantation of a transfiguration spell that could be used to transform the colour and style of the caster's hair.

cruciatus-curse.effect: The Cruciatus Curse (Crucio), also known as the Torture Curse, was a tool of the Dark Arts and one of the three Unforgivable Curses. When cast successfully on the victim, the curse inflicted intense, excruciating physical pain on them, and would result in insanity if they were subjected to it for a prolonged time. The penalty for the use of this curse on another human being was a life sentence in Azkaban, unless there was enough evidence that the caster did so under the influence of the Imperius Curse. Two well-known victims of this curse were former Aurors Alice and Frank Longbottom: the Longbottoms were tortured into insanity with it by Death Eaters Bellatrix, Rodolphus, and Rabastan Lestrange, and Barty Crouch Jnr.
cruciatus-curse.effectFr: Un des " Sortilèges Impardonnables , " Ce sortilège inflige à la victime une douleur presque intolérable. Certains sont devenus fous d'avoir subi ce sortilège trop longtemps.

curse-of-the-bogies.effect: The Curse of the Bogies (Mucus ad Nauseam), was a curse that gave the recipient a nasty cold and an extremely runny nose that could cause the victim to collapse if it were not treated. The cold was accompanied with constant sneezing. No further casts of this curse had any additional effect on the target, unless the Duo or Tria modifiers were used. There existed a counter-curse of unknown incantation covered in the Updated Counter-Curse Handbook, Second Revised Edition. Presumably the Pepperup Potion would cure the effects as well, though the Antidote to Common Poisons was notably reported to work.

cushioning-charm.effect: The Cushioning Charm (Molliare) was a charm that created a cushioning effect on the target. It was primarily used in broomstick manufacturing to make the brooms more comfortable for riders.
cushioning-charm.effectFr: Le sortilège de Coussinage créé un "coussin" invisible sur le manche du balai, rendant le vol plus confortable.

dancing-feet-spell.effect: The Dancing Feet Spell (Tarantallegra) was a charm that made a target's legs spasm wildly out of control, making it appear as though they were dancing. It worked on both living and inanimate targets, so long as it had legs. It was mainly used to humiliate a victim, but it could be also be used in duelling.
dancing-feet-spell.effectFr: Force les jambes de la victime à s'agiter selon une danse folle.

dangling-jinx.effect: The Dangling Jinx (Levicorpus) was a jinx, which was intended to be cast nonverbally but the incantation could also be spoken aloud, caused the victim to be hoisted into the air by their ankle; the counter-jinx for this jinx was Liberacorpus.
dangling-jinx.effectFr: Suspend dans les airs la cible par la cheville.

densaugeo.effect: Densaugeo was the incantation of a hex which caused the front teeth to elongate at an alarming rate.

deprimo.effect: The Deprimo Spell (Deprimo) charm used to blast holes in the ground. It was strong enough to shatter the floor of an entire room in a matter of seconds.

descending-charm.effect: The Descending Charm (Descendo) was a charm that made objects fall or move downwards. It could also be used to stop the victim of a Billywig sting from floating, although the effect was only temporary.

desk-into-pig.effect: Desk Into Pig (incantation unknown) was a transforming spell that turned desks into pigs. It was a relatively advanced transfiguration spell.

deterioration-hex.effect: The Deterioration Hex was a hex that impaired foes and reduced their stamina.

diminuendo.effect: Diminuendo was the incantation for a charm that caused the target, such as humans, to shrink.

disarming-charm.effect: The Disarming Charm (Expelliarmus) was a charm that forced whatever an opponent was holding to fly out of their hand. It was common to see this spell used in duels to make an opponent lose their wand.
disarming-charm.effectFr: Fait s'envoler de ses mains l'arme d'un adversaire.

surgito.effect: The Disenchantment Charm (Surgito) was a counter-charm that could be used to remove an enchantment.

disillusionment-charm.effect: The Disillusionment Charm was a charm that disguised a target as its surroundings by making it take on the exact colour and texture of its environment, effectively turning it into a chameleon. Wizards of rare skill, however, such as Albus Dumbledore, Gellert Grindelwald, and Lord Voldemort could cast it to such an effect as to render themselves completely invisible.
disillusionment-charm.effectFr: Sortilège qui fait perdre le sens des réalités, de la vérité.

disintegration-spell.effect: This spell was a Dark charm that caused the person who was hit to burst into small pieces and disintegrate.

partis-temporus.effect: The Dividing Charm (Partis Temporus) was a charm that temporarily parted the target, creating a gap wherever the caster pointed their wand. This spell was effective in producing a magical partition in a Firestorm.

doubling-charm.effect: The Doubling Charm or Duplication Charm (Geminio) was a charm used to duplicate an object, creating an exact replica of that object, nearly impossible to tell apart from the original. This spell could also be used with an alternate incantation to make it function as a curse, known as the Gemino Curse (Gemino), so that an object would continuously replicate itself ad infinitum, triggered when the object was touched by someone. The result was that the space would fill up and crush any intruder or trespasser under the weight of replicated items.

draconifors-spell.effect: The Draconifors Spell (Draconifors) was a transfiguration spell used to transform objects into small dragons.

drought-charm.effect: The Drought Charm was a charm used to dry up small bodies of water, such as puddles and ponds. It was not powerful enough to work on larger bodies of water, such as lakes.

ducklifors.effect: Ducklifors was the incantation of a transfiguration jinx that transformed an organism into a duck. Fourth-years and above were able to cast the spell, meaning it was likely taught in Transfiguration class during or before the fourth year.

dumbledore-s-army-parchment-jinx.effect: This jinx was used by Hermione Granger in 1995 as a safeguard against traitors within Dumbledore's Army. Hermione placed it on a piece of parchment signed by all D.A. members so that if any of them betrayed the group, boils would form on his or her face across the cheeks and nose, forming the word "SNEAK".

ear-shrivelling-curse.effect: The Ear-Shrivelling Curse caused the target's ears to shrivel up.

ears-to-kumquats-spell.effect: This spell was a transforming spell that transfigured the victim's ears into kumquats. The 1 September, 1995 edition of The Quibbler claimed that turning certain published runes upside-down would reveal this spell.

ebublio-jinx.effect: The Ebublio Jinx or Bubble Jinx (Ebublio) was a jinx that entrapped the target in a very large bubble that could not be popped by physical force or seen through by the individual trapped inside. Filius Flitwick invented a modified version of this jinx which the target could see out of, which he used during the House Points Scramble.

echo-detection-charm.effect: The Echo-detection Charm was a charm used to release waves of force that rebounded to the caster when hitting a target.

engorgement-charm.effect: The Engorgement Charm (Engorgio), also known as Growing Charm, was a charm that caused the target to swell immensely. It was the counter-charm for the Shrinking Charm, causing shrunken objects to return to their original size. If the caster attempted to engorge the target beyond a certain point, it would violently explode. Although this spell was safe to use on animals, its use was not recommended until the counter-charm had been perfected. Per Gamp's Law of Elemental Transfiguration, this spell could be used to increase the amount of food or drink available to someone, however doing this in a paying establishment was frowned upon. In particular, Rosmerta permanently banned anyone who performed this spell on one of her butterbeers from the Three Broomsticks Inn. A variation of this spell was Engorgio Skullus, which made the head of a person bigger.

engorgio-skullus.effect: Engorgio Skullus was the incantation of a Dark charm used to swell the head of the victim. It was a variation of the Engorgement Charm. The counter-curse was the Head Shrink Spell.

entrail-expelling-curse.effect: The Entrail-Expelling Curse was a curse. Its effects were unknown, but presumably it caused one's entrails to be expelled from the body, or more than likely (being invented by a Healer) a curse used to expel blockages from entrails, aka intestines, by causing defecation.
entrail-expelling-curse.effectFr: Apparemment, ce maléfice fait sortir les viscères de la victime hors d'elle !

episkey.effect: Episkey was the incantation of a healing charm that healed relatively minor injuries such as broken noses, toes, and split lips.

epoximise.effect: Epoximise was the incantation of a Transfiguration spell that bonded two objects together, possibly by transforming an object into an adhesive or by conjuring a sticky substance. The 2579th edition of Transfiguration Today contained a debate on the pros and cons of using this spell.

eradication-spell.effect: The Eradication Spell (Deletrius) was a charm that could disintegrate certain objects and served as the counter-charm to Prior Incantato, vanishing the shadow emitted from the wand.
eradication-spell.effectFr: Efface l'image fantomatique des sorts révélés par la formule Priori Incatatum. Peut-être cette formule peut-elle aussi effacer les effets d'autres sorts.

erecto.effect: Erecto was the incantation of a charm that straightened out the target object and set it up.

everte-statum.effect: Everte Statum was the incantation of a charm that caused opponent to fly back several feet, and caused a short sharp pain depending on the strength of the spell, but did not cause any lasting damage.

expulso-curse.effect: The Expulso Curse (Expulso) was a curse used to produce immense explosions, blasting the target apart with a burst of blue light; it had enough force to throw people into walls.

extension-charm.effect: The Extension Charm (Capacious Extremis) was a charm that expanded the internal dimensions of an object without affecting the external dimensions, enhancing its capacity, and rendering its contents lighter. This charm was advanced magic and heavily controlled by the Ministry of Magic.

extinguishing-spell.effect: The Extinguishing Spell , also known as the Extinguishing Charm, was a charm that put out fires.

false-memory-spell.effect: This was a spell , which could be used by a witch or wizard to implant a false memory into their victim's mind, without the victim realising it was not originally theirs. It differed from the Memory Charm, in that the latter erased memories whilst this one added them, albeit wholly artificial ones.

feather-light-charm.effect: The spell was a charm used to make heavy objects as light as a feather.

ferret-to-human-spell.effect: This spell is used to transform a ferret into a human, and serves as the reversal for the human to ferret spell. It was used by Minerva McGonagall on Draco Malfoy in 1994.

fianto-duri.effect: Fianto Duri was the incantation of a charm that, when combined with a protective spell such as Protego Maxima, could cause magical defences to become hard or more durable.

fidelius-charm.effect: The Fidelius Charm was a very powerful spell used to hide things or places, or to conceal secrets. It was an extremely difficult, multifaceted, and potent charm that could be used to conceal a secret inside an individual's soul. The witch or wizard who housed the secret was known as the Secret Keeper. A dwelling whose location had been protected by this spell was then invisible, intangible, unplottable, and soundproof. This was an extremely old spell, one of the most ancient of all.
fidelius-charm.effectFr: Sortilège complexe et très puissant qui dissimule une ou plusieurs personnes ; leur cachette n'est connue que de celui qui est désigné comme "Gardien du Secret".

fiendfyre.effect: Fiendfyre, or the Fiendfyre Curse (Pestis Incendium), was a deadly curse that produced powerful enchanted flames of immense size and heat that were capable of destroying nearly anything and everything in its path, taking the form of gigantic fiery magical beasts such as serpents, chimaeras, and dragons that sought out living targets. The extremely volatile and sentient cursed fire spread rapidly, and incinerated nearly everything through mere physical contact. Fiendfyre required extreme skill and intense concentration to control. This curse was an advanced type of Dark Magic, and it was one of the few known substances capable of destroying Horcruxes. The curse was also similar, but different to the protective dark charm Protego Diabolica.

finestra-spell.effect: The Finestra spell (Finestra) was a charm which shattered glass. This spell was useful in that it made very little sound, allowing for discreet entry through a window.

finger-removing-jinx.effect: This jinx , would remove a person's fingers from their hand.

fire-making-spell.effect: The Fire-Making Spell, also known as the Fire-Making Charm (Incendio) was a charm that conjured a jet of flames that could be used to set things alight.

firestorm.effect: The Firestorm was a charm which produced a large ring of fire from around the caster's wand.

flagrante-curse.effect: The Flagrante Curse (Flagrante) was a curse that caused objects to emit searing heat when touched.

flagrate.effect: Flagrate is the incantation of a charm that allows one to write or draw in midair with fiery lines. The shape lingers for some time.
flagrate.effectFr: Crée une ligne enflammée en l'air qui peut être dirigée avec la baguette magique pour former diverses formes.

flame-freezing-charm.effect: The Flame-Freezing Charm was a charm that altered the effects of fire such that instead of burning, it gave off a pleasant sensation, such as a warm summer breeze or a gentle tickling sensation. This spell could not be used to enchant corpses and Inferi to take away their weakness for fire, as it was a known fact that there was no known spell that could prevent dead flesh from burning.
flame-freezing-charm.effectFr: Change les propriétés du feu de sorte que sa chaleur n'est plus qu'une brise tiède.

flask-conjuring-spell.effect: This unidentified spell conjured a glass flask out of thin air. On 1 May, 1998, Hermione Granger used this spell to collect the memories of a dying Severus Snape.

flintifors.effect: Flintifors was the incantation of a Transfiguration spell that turned the target into a matchbox.

flipendo-maxima.effect: Flipendo Maxima was the incantation for a more powerful variation of the Knockback Jinx, which threw the target back further and with greater force than the original spell.

flipendo-tria.effect: Flipendo Tria was a jinx that threw the target longer than its less powerful Flipendo and Flipendo Duo. It resembled a small tornado. The spell targeted multiple opponents.

flying-charm.effect: This flying charm was a charm cast on objects to allow them to fly. It was cast on broomsticks and flying carpets.

fogging-spell.effect: The Fogging Spell (Nebulus) was a charm that conjured fog from the tip of the wand.

fortifundus.effect: Fortifundus was the incantation for a Transfiguration spell. Its exact effect was unknown.

foundables-spell.effect: The Foundables Spell was cast sometime in the 21st century, likely by Grim Fawley, to unleash the Calamity, leading to numerous breaches of the International Statute of Wizarding Secrecy and the creation of Fortresses.

four-point-spell.effect: The Four-Point Spell (Point Me) was a charm that caused the caster's wand to behave as if it were a compass and point north.

fracto-strata.effect: Fracto Strata was the incantation of a spell which could break weak objects into pieces. It was a beginner level spell and was thus known by almost all wizards and witches.

freezing-charm.effect: The Freezing Charm (Immobulus) was a charm which immobilised and stopped the actions of the target. With the use of this charm, the movement of living or animated targets was stopped, and the functioning of objects such as Muggle burglar alarms was halted. It could also be used to render a Whomping Willow safely immobile.

freezing-spell.effect: The Freezing Spell (Glacius), also known as the Glacius Charm, was a charm that froze a target with icy-cold air created from the tip of the wand. This, in turn, could freeze water, extinguish fires and freeze opponents. There existed a spellbook for this charm.

full-body-bind-curse.effect: The Full Body-Bind Curse (Petrificus Totalus), also known as the Body Freezing Spell, was a curse that temporarily paralysed the opponent. It was often used by inexperienced or young wizards and witches in duelling. This curse could be found in Curses and Counter-Curses by Vindictus Viridian.
full-body-bind-curse.effectFr: Rend le corps de la victime entièrement rigide.

fumos-duo.effect: Fumos Duo was the incantation for the most powerful version of the Smokescreen Spell. It could conjure multiple clouds of dark red smoke. This spell was quite useful in duelling, as the thick smoke hid the target, making it difficult for an opponent to accurately aim their spells through the smoke.

fur-spell.effect: This spell (incantation unknown) was a charm used to cover the victim in fur.

general-counter-spell.effect: The General Counter-Spell (Finite or Finite Incantatem) was a counter-spell for general use. It might have been used in duels to counter or reverse minor damage, such as the effects of minor jinxes, hexes and curses. It could also be used on an entire home to (temporarily) stop the effects of protective enchantments, as a precaution before a Muggle answered the door. The General Counter-Spell was taught at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in second-year and third-year Charms class. This spell was also covered in The Standard Book of Spells, Grade 2 by Miranda Goshawk.
general-counter-spell.effectFr: Interrompt l'effet du sortilège en cours.

glacius-duo.effect: Glacius Duo was a charm used offensively in duelling to freeze a target enemy in ice. It was a more powerful version of Glacius, but was not as powerful as Glacius Tria.

glacius-tria.effect: Glacius Tria was a charm used offensively in duelling to freeze a target enemy. It was the most effective version of Glacius, being more powerful than Glacius and Glacius Duo.

golemus-mobilia.effect: Golemus Mobilia was the incantation for a Transfiguration. Its exact effect was unknown.

gouging-spell.effect: The Gouging Spell (Defodio) was a charm used to gouge out specific areas of material, such as earth or stone.

greenhouse-charm.effect: The Greenhouse Charm (Celescere) was a charm that helped the growth of plant-based potion ingredients in greenhouses.

green-sparks.effect: Green Sparks was a charm which precipitated a jet of green sparks from the tip of the wand, something that might be useful to signal an emergency and call for help. It could also be used offensively as a minor duelling spell. It was covered in the book The Dark Forces: A Guide to Self-Protection.

gripping-charm.effect: The Gripping Charm was a charm that made a certain object easier to hold on to.
gripping-charm.effectFr: Sort qui permet de saisir un objet plus facilement.

growth-charm.effect: The Growth Charm was a charm that increased the physical size of the target. Its incantation was similar to that of the Colour Change Charm. It was probably related to the Engorgement Charm.

gusts.effect: Gusts was a dark spell used to create a rush of wind which caused damage in a duel or battle, even if the enemies were under a shield protection.

gytrash-conjuring-spell.effect: This spell conjured green, transparent Gytrashes through green bolts of light. These Gytrashes were powerful, but could be vanquished with the Wand-Lighting Charm.

hair-loss-curse.effect: The Hair Loss Curse (Calvorio) was a curse that removed the victim's hair or headdress.

hair-thickening-charm.effect: The Hair-Thickening Charm (incantation unknown) was a charm which caused the target's hair to grow longer and thicker very quickly.

hardening-charm.effect: The Hardening Charm (Duro) was a charm that turned an object to stone.

hardenus.effect: Hardenus was the incantation for a Transfiguration spell. Its exact effect was unknown.

head-shrink-spell.effect: The Head Shrink Spell (Redactum Skullus) was a Dark charm that could be used to shrink the skull and surrounding tissue of the head of the victim. It was the counter-curse to Engorgio Skullus.

herbifors.effect: Herbifors was the incantation for a transforming spell that turned the target into a bunch of flowers. It could work on an individual's head of hair.

herbivicus-charm.effect: The Herbivicus Charm, also known as the Herbivicus Spell or Gardening Charm, (Herbivicus) was a charm used to rapidly increase the growth rate of plants and cause flowers to bloom. Herbivicus Duo was a stronger version of this charm.

herstrifors.effect: Herstrifors was the incantation for a Transfiguration. Its exact effect was unknown.

homing-spell.effect: Homing spells were powerful offensive spells that followed their target with a constant speed after being cast. They caused significant damage to the target.

homorphus-charm.effectFr: Un bon sortilège contre les loups-garous. Ses effets exacts ne sont pas connus.

horcrux-making-spell.effect: This Dark spell was used to prepare a receptacle for the placing of a fragmented piece of soul within it, thereby allowing the target to become a Horcrux, tethering the caster to the mortal world and preventing their death.

horn-tongue-hex.effect: Fait apparaître une corne sur la langue de la cible. Quel avantage cela représente, on se le demande !
horn-tongue-hex.effectFr: Fait apparaître une corne sur la langue de la cible. Quel avantage cela représente, on se le demande !

horton-keitch-braking-charm.effect: The Horton-Keitch Braking Charm was a charm patented by Basil Horton and Randolph Keitch that allowed for broom-riders to stop more precisely. It was applied to all broomsticks built by the Comet Trading Company. This particular Slowing Charm allowed Quidditch players to be less likely to overshoot goals or fly offside.
horton-keitch-braking-charm.effectFr: Rend les balais de course plus faciles à tenir.

hot-air-charm.effect: The Hot Air Charm was a charm that streamed hot air out of the caster's wand. This air in turn could quickly dry off soaked garments.

hour-reversal-charm.effect: The Hour-Reversal Charm was a charm that could be used to reverse time by one hour every time the hour-glass was revolved. It was invented some time between 1890 and 1899.

hover-charm.effect: The Hover Charm was a charm which made the target hover in mid-air for a brief period of time. It was one of the many lesser variations of the Levitation Charm, and worked on both objects and people.
hover-charm.effectFr: Fait flotter un objet en l'air.

human-presence-revealing-spell.effect: The Human-presence-revealing Spell (Homenum Revelio) was a charm which revealed the presence of other humans in the surrounding environment. The spell indicated a body by a marker. It was also a variation of the Revelio Charm.

hurling-hex.effect: The Hurling Hex was a hex that could be applied to a broomstick, which would cause the broomstick to attempt to hurl its rider off.
hurling-hex.effectFr: Un maléfice assez vache qui peut être placé sur un balai et probablement provoquer la chute du conducteur.

ice-jinx.effect: The Ice Jinx was a jinx used to generate a small block of ice.

ignition-spell.effect: The Ignition Spell (Inflamare) was used to light a target via a small fireball.

illegibilus.effect: Illegibilus was the incantation of a charm that made writing impossible to read.

impediment-jinx.effect: The Impediment Jinx (Impedimenta), also known as the Impediment Hex, was a jinx that hindered the movement of the target, slowing it down or stopping it in its tracks. It was a common spell used in duelling, and since it only caused minimal damage, it was commonly taught in schools, including in Hogwarts' Duelling Club.

imperius-curse.effect: The Imperius Curse (Imperio) was a tool of the Dark Arts, and was one of the three Unforgivable Curses. When cast successfully, the curse placed the victim completely under the caster's control, making the victim unquestionably obedient to the caster. A person under the curse was said to be Imperiused. Notably, a person with exceptional strength of will could resist the curse. The fact that this curse could be directly defended against, made it unique amongst the Unforgivable Curses. The penalty for using this curse in Great Britain was the same as for the other two Unforgivable Curses (the Killing Curse and the Cruciatus Curse): a life sentence in Azkaban.
imperius-curse.effectFr: Un des "Sortilèges Impardonnables". Ce sort met la victime sous contrôle total de l'auteur qui peut lui faire faire ce qu'il veut.

imperturbable-charm.effect: The Imperturbable Charm was a charm that created an invisible magical barrier around an object, such as a door. Objects would bounce off of the barrier, and it also muffled sounds, like the Muffliato Charm. An object enchanted in this manner was said to have been "Imperturbed".
imperturbable-charm.effectFr: Crée une barrière magique sur un objet, comme une porte, pour éviter qu'on écoute aux portes.

impervius-charm.effect: The Impervius Charm (Impervius) was a charm that made an object repel water and mist. This could be used to allow someone better sight in bad weather conditions by preventing the rain from hitting their faces. This charm did not repel solid objects, as seen when Hermione Granger attempted to defend herself and her comrades against the cascading and burning treasures in the Lestrange Vault.
impervius-charm.effectFr: Rend les choses étanches ou imperméables.

inanimatus-conjurus-spell.effect: The Inanimatus Conjurus Spell (Inanimatus Conjurus) was a transfiguration spell used to alter the design of a room.

incarcerous-spell.effect: The Incarcerous Spell (Incarcerous), also known as the Binding Jinx, was a spell that conjured thick ropes or thin cords from "thin air", that bound whatever the caster was pointing their wand at.
incarcerous-spell.effectFr: Envoie des cordes surgies de nulle part qui s'enroulent autour de quelqu'un ou quelque chose.

incendio-duo-spell.effect: The Incendio Duo Spell (Incendio) was a charm that conjured green flames. It was a stronger variation of the Fire-Making Spell, but not as strong as Incendio Tria.

incendio-tria.effect: Incendio Tria was the incantation of a charm that conjured blue flames; the average first or second-year Hogwarts student could perform this spell. This charm was an improvement over both Incendio and Incendio Duo, and consequently created larger flames than either spell.

inflating-charm.effect: The Inflating Charm (Inflatus) was a charm (sometimes referred to as a jinx) that inflated the target.

informous-spell.effect: The Informous Spell (Informous) was a charm that added a page with information regarding the charmed creature to the caster's Folio Bruti.

inn-charm.effect: The Inn Charm (Tribuomnus) was a charm that improved the quality of food served at wizarding Inns.

insect-hex.effect: The Insect Hex (Entomorphis), also known as the Insect Jinx, was a dark charm that could be used to induce insect-like qualities upon a victim for a short period of time. It deprived them of their ability to speak, forcing them to crawl about and endowing them with .

instant-scalping-hex.effect: This was a hex that instantly scalped all the hair off of a target.

intruder-charm.effect: The Intruder Charm was a charm which detected intruders and sounded an alarm, the magical-equivalent to a burglar alarm.

jelly-brain-jinx.effect: The Jelly-Brain Jinx was a jinx that reduced one's mental abilities.

jelly-fingers-curse.effect: The Jelly-Fingers Curse was a curse that caused the victim's fingers to become wobbly, as if they had been turned to jelly.

jelly-legs-curse.effect: The Jelly-Legs Curse, also known as the Jelly-Legs Jinx (Locomotor Wibbly) was a dark charm that caused the victim's legs to collapse as if they were turned to jelly. This spell was covered in Curses and Counter-Curses by Professor Vindictus Viridian. This spell would have unpleasant side effects if used in conjunction with the Pimple Jinx, namely causing little tentacles to sprout all over the victim's face.

killing-curse.effect: The Killing Curse (Avada Kedavra) was a tool of the Dark Arts and was one of the three Unforgivable Curses. When cast successfully on a living person or creature, the curse caused instantaneous and painless death, without causing any injury to the body, and without any trace of violence. The Killing Curse was accompanied by a blinding flash or jet of green light and a distinctive rushing sound when being cast. The only known counter-spell to this curse was sacrificial protection, which used the power of love. The Killing Curse was a conventionally unblockable curse; therefore shield charms would not be able to defend against it. However, one could dodge the green bolt, block it with a physical barrier, by the use of Priori Incantatem, or Disapparate if they wanted to quickly get away before the curse hit them.
killing-curse.effectFr: Provoque la mort instantanée dans un éclair de lumière verte.

knee-reversal-hex.effect: The knee-reversal hex was a hex which was invented in or before the 12th century.

knitting-charm.effect: The Knitting Charm was a charm used to bewitch knitting needles to perform their task autonomously.

knockback-jinx.effect: The Knockback Jinx (Flipendo) was a jinx that knocked the target backwards. While prominently used for duelling, it could also be used to push heavy objects. It was covered in Quentin Trimble's The Dark Forces: A Guide to Self-Protection, a Defence Against the Dark Arts textbook.

knockback-jinx-duo.effect: The Knockback Jinx Duo ( Flipendo) was a more powerful version of the Knockback Jinx. It was twice as powerful as the standard Knockback Jinx, but it was not as powerful as Flipendo Tria.

lacarnum-inflamari.effect: Lacarnum Inflamari was the incantation of a charm used to ignite cloaks or other items of clothing worn by individuals.

laceration-curse.effect: The Laceration Curse (Sectumsempra) was a curse invented by Severus Snape that lacerated the target and caused severe bleeding. Snape created it as a student of Hogwarts, and contrary to other spells he created for usage against opponents in duels, like Langlock and the Dangling Jinx, he explicitly marked for usage against enemies. It was one of his signature spells.

langlock.effect: Langlock was the incantation of a jinx that caused one's tongue to affix to the roof of their mouth. It was known to work on humans as well as on spirits (including a poltergeist, like Peeves). It was most likely invented for the sake of preventing someone from speaking aloud or even to prevent a spell from being cast.

lapifors-spell.effect: The Lapifors Spell (Lapifors) was a transforming spell that could be used to transform the target into a rabbit; it worked best on smaller targets such as statues, salamanders or cats. The spell could be viewed as a jinx when used to transform creatures into rabbits.

leek-jinx.effect: The Leek jinx was a jinx that could be used to make leeks sprout from the victim's ears.

legilimency-spell.effect: The Legilimency Spell (Legilimens) was a charm that allowed the caster to perform Legilimency; in other words, to delve into the mind of the victim, permitting the caster to see memories, emotions and thoughts. Skilled Legilimens (such as Tom Riddle) was able to perform Legilimency without using the incantation or a wand. Highly skilled Legilimens were able to control their victims and create realistic visions.

leg-locker-curse.effect: The Leg-Locker Curse (Locomotor Mortis), also known as the Leg Locking Spell was a curse that bound the legs of the victim together.

levitation-charm.effect: The Levitation Charm (Wingardium Leviosa) was a charm used to make objects fly, or levitate. It was taught to first-years at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. There were a number of lesser variations of the Levitation Charm, such as the Levitation Spell, the Hover Charm, the Rocket Charm, and the Floating Charm, but the Levitation Charm remained the original and best.

levitation-spell.effect: The Levitation Spell (Levioso) was a charm that levitated objects. However, it did not also allow one to move said objects (unlike a similar spell). It could also be used to levitate people in duelling. Levitated Diricawls could not disappear and reappear as usual.
levitation-spell.effectFr: La lévitation permet à une personne ou un objet de flotter un mètre cinquante au dessus du sol.

liberacorpus.effect: Liberacorpus was the incantation for the counter-jinx to the Dangling Jinx (Levicorpus). Both spells were invented by Severus Snape.

locking-spell.effect: The Locking Spell, also known as the Locking Charm, (Colloportus) was a charm that closed and locked doors, making it so that they could not be opened manually. This charm was featured in The Standard Book of Spells, Grade 1 and its counter-charms were the Unlocking Charms (Alohomora, Dunamis, Liberare, Annihilare, etc.)
locking-spell.effectFr: Scelle une porte, dans un étrange bruit de succion.

locomotion-charm.effect: The Locomotion Charm (Locomotor) was a charm that enabled a witch or wizard to levitate an object a few inches off of the ground and then move said object in any given direction with out having to carry them. It was particularly useful for moving heavy items. This spell was described as basic.
locomotion-charm.effectFr: Déplace un objet ou une personne. Le terme "Locomotor" est souvent suivi du nom de la cible, de l'objet que l'on souhaite déplacer.

lumos-duo.effect: Lumos Duo was a variation of the Wand-Lighting Charm. It created a focused beam of light from the end of the wand.

lumos-maxima.effect: Lumos Maxima was the incantation to a charm that could be used to produce a blinding flash of bright white light from the tip of the wand, a modified version of the Wand-Lighting Charm.

magicus-extremos.effect: Magicus Extremos was the incantation of a partnership-based charm that temporarily increased the casters' spell power. In order to activate this effect, at least three wizards and/or witches were needed to cast the charm simultaneously, which then invoked significantly increased power for a short while.

memory-charm.effect: The Memory Charm (Obliviate), also known as the Forgetfulness Charm, was a charm that could be used to erase specific memories from an individual's mind. It was different from the spell that created false memories.

mending-charm.effect: The Mending Charm, also known as the Repairing Charm (Reparo), was a charm that could be used to seamlessly repair a broken or ripped object and worked on most materials. This incredibly useful and practical charm was invented by Orabella Nuttley, in or before 1754.
mending-charm.effectFr: Annule les dommages subits par des choses ou objets.

meteolojinx-recanto.effect: Meteolojinx recanto was the incantation to a counter-charm that caused weather effects caused by Weather-Modifying Charms such as the Atmospheric Charm to cease.

ministry-of-magic-fog.effect: The Ministry of Magic Fog was a patented charm that was used by the British Ministry of Magic to conceal certain areas from Muggle view.

mobiliarbus.effect: Mobiliarbus was the incantation of a charm that enabled a witch or wizard to levitate a wooden target a few inches off of the ground and then move said object in any given direction. It worked on trees and wands.

mobilicorpus.effect: Mobilicorpus was the incantation of a charm which was used to move bodies by suspending them a few inches above the air. This spell was able to move people who find themselves unable to walk, regardless of whether or not they are conscious. It may have been a variation of the same basic spell Mobiliarbus was, linked by a base Latin word.

morsmordre.effect: Morsmordre was the incantation of a symbol-conjuring spell used to conjure the image of the Dark Mark, the skull-and-serpent sign used by Lord Voldemort and his Death Eaters, in the sky. The Death Eaters cast their mark over the homes of anyone they killed as their calling card. It was said to have been created by Lord Voldemort himself. It could be removed with an Eradication Spell.
morsmordre.effectFr: Fait apparaître dans le ciel un immense crâne entouré d'étoile vertes, avec un serpent sortant de sa bouche.

muffliato-charm.effect: The Muffliato Charm (Muffliato) was a charm used to fill the ears of any person in the vicinity of the caster with an unidentifiable buzzing sound so as to allow for conversation without being overheard, similar to the Imperturbable Charm.

muggle-repelling-charm.effect: The Muggle-Repelling Charm (Repello Muggletum) was a charm that prevented Muggles from seeing or entering an area. Any non-magic person that would get close to the vicinity of the enchantment would remember something urgent to do and leave.
muggle-repelling-charm.effectFr: Aussi présenté comme sortilèges Repousse-Moldus [Repello Muggle Repelling Charms].

multicorfors-spell.effect: The Multicorfors Spell (Multicorfors) was a transfiguration spell that could be used to change the colour and style of the target's outfit.

mutatio-skullus.effect: Mutatio Skullus was the incantation to a dark charm which presumably mutated the victim's head, given its name.

obliteration-charm.effect: The Obliteration Charm was a charm used to remove footprints, including imprints or stains.
obliteration-charm.effectFr: Efface les traces ou la piste laissées par quelqu'un.

obscuro.effect: Obscuro was the incantation of a charm used to conjure a blindfold over the eyes of the victim, therefore obstructing their view of their surroundings.

oculus-reparo.effect: Oculus Reparo was the incantation of a charm that repaired broken eyeglasses. It was a variant of the Mending Charm.
oculus-reparo.effectFr: Simple sort pour réparer une paire de lunettes.

one-eyed-witch-spell.effect: The One-Eyed Witch Spell (Dissendium) was a charm used to open the One-Eyed Witch Passage in the Gunhilda of Gorsemoor Corridor at Hogwarts Castle. The incantation Dissendium could be used to open secret passageways in general.
one-eyed-witch-spell.effectFr: Incertain : "dissocio" L. diviser ? Même sonorité que "descendre".

opening-charm.effect: The Opening Charm (Aberto) was a charm which opened doors.

oppugno-jinx.effect: The Oppugno Jinx (Oppugno) was a jinx that directed an object or individual to attack the victim. This spell would cause conjured creatures or other movable objects under the control of the caster to attack the target.

orbis.effect: Orbis was the incantation of a jinx used to suck the target into the ground. It could only be used if an ally was levitating the target whilst the spell was being cast.

oscausi.effect: Oscausi was the incantation of a Dark charm that could be used to seal someone's mouth shut. The victim's mouth would appear as if it was never there, with skin covering the area. The victim would also be muted as a consequence.

pack-charm.effect: The Pack Charm (Pack) was a charm used to make items pack themselves into a trunk.
pack-charm.effectFr: Une formule qui fait se rassembler les affaires dans la valise.

pain-extraction-spell.effect: This healing spell could remove the feeling of pain, mental and presumably also physical, from another person and draw it onto the tip of the caster's wand. The spell was tied to ancient magic. However, it also appeared to drain the target of all emotion if it was used too much. The energy drained turned into corrupted ancient magic. The spell was a form of Dark magic. According to Niamh Fitzgerald, the spell left "Dark" traces.

papyrus-reparo.effect: Papyrus Reparo was the incantation of a charm that could be used to mend torn pieces of paper. It was a variant of the Mending Charm.

patented-daydream-charm.effect: The Patented Daydream Charm was a magical item created by Fred and George Weasley, sold at their shop Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes in Diagon Alley.

patronus-charm.effect: The Patronus Charm (Expecto Patronum) was the most famous and one of the most powerful defensive charms known to wizardkind. It was an immensely complicated and extremely difficult spell that channelled the caster's positive emotions into a powerful protection. When cast properly, it evoked a partially-tangible positive energy force known as a Patronus (pl. Patronuses) or spirit guardian. It was the primary protection against Dementors and Lethifolds, against which there were no other defences. There were two types of Patronuses: the incorporeal variant, which took the form of a shapeless wave of mist, and the corporeal variant, which had a definite shape, taking on the form of the animal that the caster had the greatest affinity for. The incorporeal Patronus was weaker than its corporeal counterpart, but the corporeal Patronus was more advanced and difficult.
patronus-charm.effectFr: Crée un Patronus, créature fantomatique, habituellement une forme d'animal qui est l'incarnation des pensées positives de l'auteur du sort. Un Patronus repousse les Détraqueurs.

pepper-breath.effect: Pepper Breath was a hex that gave the target fiery hot breath.
pepper-breath.effectFr: Ce sortilège donne à une personne une haleine de feu.

periculum.effect: Periculum was the incantation of a charm that allowed the caster to shoot red sparks from their wand.

permanent-sticking-charm.effect: The Permanent Sticking Charm was a charm that magically stuck one object to another indefinitely. It was unknown how, if at all, this charm could be lifted, leaving an object to stick indefinitely.
permanent-sticking-charm.effectFr: Sort qui colle magiquement une chose à une autre. Il est extrêmement difficile de détacher quelque chose collé à la Glu perpétuelle.

peskipiksi-pesternomi.effect: Peskipiksi Pesternomi was supposedly the incantation of a charm meant to capture (or possibly repel) pixies.

pimple-jinx.effect: The Pimple Jinx, also known as the Furnunculus Curse (Furnunculus), was a Dark charm that caused a person to break out in boils/pimples when it came in contact with their skin. It could induce acne. The effects could be cleared by the Boil-Cure Potion.
pimple-jinx.effectFr: De "furunculus" L. "petit voleur", qui a donné le mot furoncle.

pinhead-jinx.effect: The Pinhead Jinx was a jinx. Its exact effect was unknown.

piscifors.effect: Piscifors was the incantation of a transforming spell that could be used to transform the target into a fish. Professor Horace Slughorn described it as being beautiful.

placement-charm.effect: The Placement Charm was a charm that magically placed an object somewhere without the wizard or witch having to do it physically. Placement Charms could be used to place a bridle on a kelpie to render it harmless and docile.
placement-charm.effectFr: Sort pour mettre quelque chose en place.

porcupine-jinx.effect: The Porcupine Jinx was a jinx. Its exact effect was unknown.

portkey-spell.effect: The Portkey Spell (Portus) was a charm used to turn an ordinary object into a Portkey. Since creating Portkeys were restricted by the Ministry of Magic, the usage of this spell was, by extension, restricted as well. This was the subject of a question of the Theory of Charms O.W.L. in 1996

reverse-spell.effect: Prior Incantato, otherwise known as the Prior-Use Spell, was a charm that forced a wand to show an "echo" of the last spell it had performed. Its counter-charm was the Eradication Spell, which removed these images. Priori Incantatem, otherwise known as the "reverse spell effect", was an especially rare manifestation of this spell that occurred when two wands with the same core (that is, taken from the same exact specimen of animal) attempted to duel each other. The winner's wand forced the loser's wand to produce "echoes" of the most recent spells performed in reverse order.
reverse-spell.effectFr: Peut être lancé comme formule (" Prior Incanto "). L'effet produit oblige la baguette à émettre une image fantomatique du dernier sort émis. Les images peuvent être détruites par la formule Deletrius .

proficiency-charm.effect: The Proficiency Charm , was a charm which could be used on an individual to boost their performance with certain individual talents.

projectile-jinx.effect: The Projectile Jinx (Waddiwasi) was a jinx that could be used to propel a small wad of material at high velocity.
projectile-jinx.effectFr: Projette une boule de chewing-gum du trou d'une serrure.

protean-charm.effect: The Protean Charm (incantation unknown) was a charm that allowed several objects to change simultaneously through a common purpose. It was considered advanced N.E.W.T.-level magic and all members of Dumbledore's Army were impressed when Hermione Granger revealed that she could cast this spell.
protean-charm.effectFr: Sortilège complexe qui fait changer quelque chose de forme.

protection-charm.effect: The Protection Charm was a charm which provided enhanced individual's defence, making them more protected from harm.

protego-horribilis.effect: Protego horribilis was the incantation of a powerful protective charm.

protego-maxima.effect: Protego Maxima was a stronger version of the Shield Charm that, when cast in combination with Fianto Duri and Repello Inimicum, conjured up an almost impregnable magical protection barrier.

protego-totalum.effect: Protego totalum was the incantation of a protective enchantment used to shield a certain area or dwelling for an extended period of time. It was a variation of the Shield Charm, and was used to stop and repel any intruder and/or spell from the protected area, except the most powerful curses, including the Unforgivable Curses.

pullus.effect: Pullus was the incantation of a transforming jinx used to transfigure the target into a chicken; in particular, Erklings were rather vulnerable to this spell.

pumpkin-head-jinx.effect: The Pumpkin-Head Jinx (Melofors), also known as the Melofors Jinx, was a jinx that encased the victim's head in a pumpkin. To outsiders, it appeared that the victim's head was transformed into a pumpkin.

purple-firecrackers.effect: Purple Firecrackers was a charm used to emit purple firecrackers from the tip of one's wand.

pus-squirting-hex.effect: The Pus Squirting Hex was a hex that caused pus to squirt from the victim's nose.

quietening-charm.effect: The Quietening Charm (Quietus) was a charm used to quieten sounds. It was the counter-charm to the Amplifying Charm.
quietening-charm.effectFr: Inverse l'effet du sortilège Sonorus , rendant à l'auteur du sortilège sa voix normale.

red-sparks.effect: Red Sparks (Vermillious) was a charm that precipitated a jet of red sparks from the tip of the wand, something that might be useful to signal an emergency and call for help. It could also be used offensively as a minor duelling spell, but it was not effective against armoured or metallic opponents. It was covered in the book The Dark Forces: A Guide to Self-Protection by Quentin Trimble. Vermillious Duo and Vermillious Tria were more powerful versions of Red Sparks.

reductor-curse.effect: The Reductor Curse (Reducto) was a curse that blasted solid objects to pieces. It was rather easy to reduce a target to a fine mist or a pile of ashes.

refilling-charm.effect: The Refilling Charm was a charm that was used to refill whatever the caster pointed at with the drink originally in the container. This charm could be used verbally or non-verbally.

reparifarge.effect: Reparifarge was the incantation of an untransfiguration spell. It appeared to be a general spell used to counter the effects of a Transformation spell that was poorly performed and only partially Transfigured the object in question. This spell was covered in A Beginner's Guide to Transfiguration, which stressed the importance of at least attempting this spell when necessary, as the products of incomplete Transfigurations could be dangerous.

reparifors.effect: Reparifors was the incantation of a healing charm that reverted minor magically-induced ailments, such as paralysis and poisoning.

revealing-charm.effect: The Revealing Charm (Aparecium) was a charm that revealed secret messages written in Invisible Ink, or any other hidden markings written using other means such as Concealing charms.

revelio-charm.effect: The Revelio Charm (Revelio) was a charm used to reveal concealed objects, messages, invisible things, and passages or any other secretly written messages and hidden markings. It was considered difficult for a second-year student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. It may have also been used to reveal the true appearance of someone who changed their appearance with a spell. It had no effect on a transformed Animagus; a different spell had to be used to force them back into human form. It was also useful for revealing disguised Chameleon Ghouls.

reverte.effect: Reverte was the incantation of a charm that could return or revert objects to their original positions or states, which might cause the targeted objects to move in reverse.

reviving-spell.effect: The Reviving Spell (Rennervate) was a spell whose effect depended on the intent of the caster, and were either categorised as a charm that could be used to awaken a living target from a state of unconsciousness, and consequently served as the counter-charm to the Stunning Spell, or as a curse that would reanimate a dead target, typically by Dark wizards, turning the corpse in question into a grisly puppet known as an Inferius.
reviving-spell.effectFr: Sort pour rendre à la vie une personne stupéfixiée.

revulsion-jinx.effect: The Revulsion Jinx (Relashio) was a jinx that forced the target to release its grip on whatever it was holding. It worked on both living and inanimate targets, so long as it was holding something.
revulsion-jinx.effectFr: Envoie un jet d'étincelles brûlantes. Sous l'eau, cette formule produit un jet d'eau bouillante.

rose-growth.effect: Rose Growth was a charm that made rosebushes grow at an unusually fast pace.

rowboat-spell.effect: This spell was a charm, that was used to propel boats on bodies of water, making them row faster.

salvio-hexia.effect: Salvio hexia was the incantation of a protective enchantment which deflected hexes from the area. The spell was a powerful protective charm, with even low-skilled casters being able to produce an enchantment which protected a small area against most hexes. The more powerful the caster, the more powerful spells it would be able to block and the larger the area protected by the spell. Extremely powerful casters could cast the spell over entire castles.

sardine-hex.effect: The Sardine Hex was a hex that caused the victim to begin sneezing up sardines.

sauce-making-spell.effect: This unidentified spell conjured a creamy sauce from the tip of the wand. Molly Weasley used this spell in August of 1994 to pour some sauce in a pot to make dinner for her family, Harry Potter and Hermione Granger.

scouring-charm.effect: The Scouring Charm (Scourgify) was a cleaning charm used for washing things. It could also be used to clean out smaller bundimun infestations. This spell was listed in the third chapter of Book of Spells by Miranda Goshawk. Many wizarding families used this spell, both for cleaning and punishing people who swore, as the spell caused human mouths to be filled with soap. This spell was also one of the few methods of effectively cleaning the teeth of a Leucrotta, as they disliked having their teeth touched with a brush.
scouring-charm.effectFr: Nettoye les choses, les ongles par exemple.

sealant-charm.effect: The Sealant Charm was a charm that magically sealed envelopes. All applicants for wand permits in the United States were required by the Magical Congress of the United States of America to close the envelope in which they sent their applications back to the Wand Permit Office with this spell.

sea-urchin-jinx.effect: The Sea Urchin Jinx was a jinx that transfigured the target victim into something similar to a sea urchin, with tiny spikes erupting all over the victim's body. It apparently created awful discomfort in the target.

seize-and-pull-charm.effect: The seize and pull charm, also known as the Carpe Retractum Spell (Carpe Retractum), was a charm that produced a magical, retractable cord of light, that could be used to pull objects towards the caster, or, if the target was fixed in place, to pull the caster towards the target.

severing-charm.effect: The Severing Charm (Diffindo) was a charm used to precisely and accurately cut something. If used inappropriately, it could cause death or injury. It was taught in first-year, fourth-year and fifth-year Charms classes at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. It was also covered in first-year and second-year Herbology classes at Hogwarts. A spellbook for this charm could be found in one of the Herbology greenhouses; the charm was also detailed in both Book of Spells and The Standard Book of Spells, Grade 1.
severing-charm.effectFr: Sortilège pour briser ou déchirer un objet.

shield-charm.effect: The Shield Charm (Protego) was a charm that protected the caster with an invisible shield that reflected spells and blocked physical entities. It was a part of the Defence Against the Dark Arts curriculum and was taught to sixth years at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. There were also multiple variations of the Shield Charm.
shield-charm.effectFr: Ce sort crée une barrière magique qui dévie les maléfices envoyés à son auteur.

shield-penetration-spell.effect: This spell , which produced a powerful bluish-white bolt, could be used to break large magical protections such as Protego horribilis.

shooting-spell.effect: This unnamed spell was used by Harry Potter and Ronald Weasley in 1997 during their Horcrux hunt in an attempt to catch a rabbit for food. The pair also engaged in a duel against each other using the spell, chasing each other about the meadow and trying to shoot each other.

shrinking-charm.effect: The Shrinking Charm (Reducio) was a charm that caused an object to shrink. It was the counter-charm to the Engorgement Charm, causing enlarged objects to return to their original size. The Shrinking Charm was also used as the potion-making spell for the Shrinking Solution. The use of a Shrinking Charm on a human was considered both complicated and dangerous.

silencing-charm.effect: The Silencing Charm (Silencio) was a charm that rendered the victim temporarily mute. Working on both beasts and beings, it was immensely difficult to perform, more so on ravens than frogs. If performed incorrectly, the target would swell up to an immense size and begin making deafening sounds.
silencing-charm.effectFr: Un sortilège pour rendre quelque chose silencieux.

singing-charm.effect: The Singing Charm (Cantis) was a charm used to make the target break out in song.

skurge-charm.effect: The Skurge Charm (Skurge) was a charm that could be used to clean up the sticky green ectoplasm created by passing ghosts. It could also be used to frighten spirits, such as the aforementioned ghosts, as well as poltergeists. It was not be confused with the more versatile Scouring Charm.

glisseo.effect: The Sliding Spell (Glisseo) was a Transfiguration spell that could be used to transform a staircase into a smooth slide. It was very old, having been in use since the Middle Ages. This spell could have been used to enchant a staircase to become a slide if certain people tried to climb it, so it was useful for preventing people from reaching a certain place. It was also useful in a combat scenario, as sliding down a slide was a much faster means of escaping pursuing enemies than running down a set of stairs.

slippery-jinx.effect: The Slippery Jinx was a jinx that made an object slippery and difficult to hold.

slowing-charm.effect: The Slowing Charm, also known as the Braking Charm, (Arresto Momentum) was a charm that could be used to slow the velocity of an object. It was taught in second-year and fifth-year Charms class at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. This charm was also placed on broomsticks to help them stop faster. The Firebolt had an "unbreakable Braking Charm" placed on it.

slug-vomiting-charm.effect: The Slug-vomiting Charm (Slugulus Eructo) was a curse, that forced the victim to vomit slugs. They may also have taken on a sallow complexion as a side-effect. It was described as a green jet of light. Treacle fudge can cure the effects in a few seconds, although it will eventually wear off on its own.

smashing-spell.effect: This spell released a burst of blue light, which caused a huge explosion that ravaged and devastated everything in its range. Additionally, it could be used to smash windows.

smokescreen-spell.effect: The Smokescreen Spell (Fumos) was a charm used to create a defensive cloud of smoke from the wand that hindered visibility. This spell was quite useful in duelling, as the smoke hid the caster, preventing an opponent from accurately aiming their spells, as well as allowing the caster to escape unseen. This spell was covered in the book The Dark Forces: A Guide to Self-Protection by Professor Quentin Trimble.

snake-summons-spell.effect: The Snake Summons Spell (Serpensortia) was a transfiguration spell that conjured a live snake from the end of the wand. Out of all of the spells used to conjure living things, The Snake Summons Spell was amongst the easiest, alongside the Bird-Conjuring Charm. The counter-spell to this conjuration was the Snake-Vanishing Spell.
snake-summons-spell.effectFr: Fait jaillir un énorme serpent du bout de la baguette.

snake-vanishing-spell.effect: The Snake-Vanishing Spell (Vipera Evanesca) was a transfiguration spell that vanished snakes. As such, it could be used as a counter-spell for the Snake Summons Spell, the fire to snake spell, or likely any other spell that produced snakes.

softening-charm.effect: The Softening Charm (Spongify) was a charm that softened objects, making them rubbery and bouncy.

sonicus.effect: Sonicus was the incantation for a spell. Its exact effect was unknown, but it didn't amplify sound.

sonorous-charm.effect: The Sonorous Charm was a charm that emitted a magnified roar from the tip of the wand. This noise disrupted all in its path, and could even be used to harm opponents.

specialis-revelio.effect: The Specialised Revealing Charm (Specialis Revelio) was a charm that revealed any spells performed on objects or potions. It was a variation of the Revelio Charm.
specialis-revelio.effectFr: Utilisé pour identifier les ingrédients d'une potion.

spider-banishing-charm.effect: The Spider-Banishing Charm (Arania Exumai) was a charm used to blast away Acromantulas or other large spiders. If the spell missed and struck a stone, it would produce a large black scorch mark, and thus was not recommended for use on humans, although casting through or along a human produced no ill effect as long as a spider was struck.

sponge-knees-curse.effect: The Sponge-Knees Curse was a curse which made the target's legs spongy, making it difficult for them to walk or stand.

squiggle-quill.effect: Squiggle Quill was a transforming spell that transfigured writing quills into worms.

stamina-charm.effect: The Stamina Charm was a charm that enhanced and restored an individual's stamina.

stealth-sensoring-spell.effect: The Stealth Sensoring Spell was a charm that detected those trying to enter an area by stealth through magical means.

sternius.effect: Sternius was the incantation of a dark charm that caused the victim to continually sneeze. This spell was used in duelling to distract and weaken the opponent.

stickfast-hex.effect: The Stickfast Hex (Colloshoo) was a hex that stuck the target's shoes to the ground, causing them to trip if they attempted to move.

stinging-jinx.effect: The Stinging Jinx , also known as the Stinging Hex, was a Dark charm that could be used to sting the victim's flesh, producing a red brand like a scorch mark and causing swelling. The Death Eater Antoine Grimalkin created a highly powerful variation of this jinx called the Frequensting, which he and his wife used to terrorise Great Britain during the First Wizarding War.

stretching-jinx.effect: The Stretching Jinx was a jinx which stretched the target.

stunning-spell.effect: The Stunning Spell (Stupefy), also known as the Stupefying Charm, or Stunner for short, was a charm that stunned the target, rendering them unconscious. This charm was exceptionally useful in duelling, as it can quickly end a duel without causing lasting damage. The spell also had the ability to halt moving objects. The counter-charm to the Stunning Spell was the Reviving Spell. It could also be defended against with the Shield Charm. Stupefy Duo was a more powerful variant of the spell.
stunning-spell.effectFr: Rend la cible inconsciente ; ce sort projette une boule de lumière rouge.

summoning-charm.effect: The Summoning Charm (Accio) was a charm that summoned an object toward the caster.
