It was able to summon objects in direct line of sight of the caster, as well as things out of view, by calling the object aloud after the incantation (unless the spell was cast nonverbally). This spell needed thought behind it, and the caster had to clearly visualise the object in their mind before trying to summon it. Any distraction would make the spell ineffective. The opposite charm of the Summoning Charm was the Banishing Charm.
summoning-charm.effectFr: Fait voler vers soi un objet, même sur une bonne distance. Il semble que l'auteur du sort doive connaître au moins de façon approximative l'endroit où se trouve l'objet à attirer.

lumos-solem-spell.effect: The Sunlight Charm (Lumos Solem), also known as the Lumos Solem Spell, was a charm used to produce a blinding flash of sunlight. As Devil's Snare hated sunlight and heat, this particular light-creation spell was very effective towards subduing it. Wearing sunglasses was advised when practising this spell to protect one's eyes from the blinding light of the spell. Specific wrist motions could modulate the volume of light the spell produced.

supersensory-charm.effect: The Supersensory Charm was a charm that gave the target enhanced senses, allowing them to more easily perceive their surroundings.

switching-spell.effect: The Switching Spell was a transfiguration spell used to switch the positions of two objects. By definition, it was a simultaneous transfiguration of two objects to make them look like each other. The spell was studied in transfiguration class by fifth-years and fourth-years respectively during the 1988–1989 and 1994–1995 school years. Hermione Granger, however, gained points for knowing about Switching Spells in her first year.
switching-spell.effectFr: Une partie des sorts de Métamorphose qui transforme une chose en une autre.

tail-growing-spell.effect: This spell caused the victim to grow a tail.

teacup-to-tortoise-spell.effect: This spell was a transforming spell used to turn a teacup into a tortoise.

teapot-to-tortoise-spell.effect: This was a transforming spell , that when cast correctly, transformed a teapot into a tortoise.

teeth-straightening-spell.effect: This spell was a charm used to straighten crooked teeth.

teleportation-spell.effect: This was a spell that vanished objects which then appeared elsewhere.

tentaclifors.effect: Tentaclifors was the incantation of a Dark charm that transfigured the head of the targeted individual into a tentacle.

terrifying-charm.effect: The Terrifying Charm was a charm. Its exact effect was unknown, but it was likely used to terrify the target.

tickling-charm.effect: The Tickling Charm, also known as the Tickle Charm, (Rictusempra) was a charm that caused the target to buckle with laughter, weakening them. It also had at least one other side effect.

tickling-hex.effect: The Tickling Hex (Titillando), also known as the Tickling Spell, was a hex that tickled and subsequently weakened the target. The spell itself manifests in ghostly purple hands that attack and tickle the target.

toenail-growing-hex.effect: This hex was used to cause the victim's toenails to grow at an alarmingly fast rate.

tongue-tying-curse.effect: The Tongue-Tying Curse (Mimblewimble), also known as the Tongue-Tying Spell, was a curse that tied the target's tongue in a knot, preventing them from making coherent speech. This feature also allowed one to prevent the victim from speaking the incantations of spells correctly, and hence like the Silencing Charm it was useful in duelling (though can be overcome with more advanced magic). It was covered in the book Curses and Counter-Curses, authored by Professor Vindictus Viridian.

tracking-spell.effect: The tracking spell (Appare Vestigium) was a charm that revealed and illuminated traces of recent magical activity and showed magical footprints and track marks in an area.

transmogrifian-torture.effect: The Transmogrifian Torture was a curse which presumably tortured its victims to death overtime.

trip-jinx.effect: The Trip Jinx was a jinx used to make people trip and fall over.

twitchy-ears-hex.effect: Force les oreilles de la victime à s'agiter et remuer de manière incontrôlable.
twitchy-ears-hex.effectFr: Force les oreilles de la victime à s'agiter et remuer de manière incontrôlable.

unbreakable-charm.effect: The Unbreakable Charm was a charm that made an object unbreakable.

unbreakable-vow.effect: An Unbreakable Vow was a spell that created a type of binding magical contract, and resulted in the imminent death of either party if they violated its terms.
unbreakable-vow.effectFr: Le sortilège doit être effectué avec une baguette tenue par l'Enchaîneur. Il doit toucher, avec sa baguette, les mains jointes de la personne effectuant le serment et de la personne le recevant. A chaque clause du serment acceptée, l'Enchaîneur fait jaillir une langue de feu rougeâtre de sa baguette qui s'enroule autour des mains des participants, restant en place et s'entrelaçant avec les autres langues de feu au fil des autres clauses du serment (PSM2).

uninviting-charm.effect: The Uninviting Charm was a charm. Its exact effect was unknown.

unlocking-charm.effect: The Unlocking Charm (Alohomora), also known as the Unlocking Spell or the Thief's Friend was a charm that unlocked objects such as doors or windows. It was also able to open doors locked by the Locking Spell (Colloportus), and as such, acted as its counter-charm. The Anti-Alohomora Charm could be used to prevent this charm from working on a locked target.
unlocking-charm.effectFr: Formule pour ouvrir une porte verrouillée.

unsupported-flight.effect: This form of flight was a spell that allowed a witch or wizard to fly without the use of a broomstick or other form of support. The spell was notably demonstrated by Lord Voldemort.

vacuum-cleaner-spell.effect: This spell was a charm used to clean any object using the wand like a vacuum cleaner.

vanishing-cabinet-repair-spell.effect: The Vanishing Cabinet Repair Spell (Harmonia Nectere Passus) was a charm used to repair a broken Vanishing Cabinet and perfect its performance. It required more than simply speaking the incantation in front of the damaged device, proven by the fact that Draco Malfoy needed nearly a year to repair one.

vanishing-spell.effect: The Vanishing Spell (Evanesco) was a Transfiguration spell used to vanish both animate and inanimate objects "into non-being, which is to say, everything".

ventus-duo.effect: Ventus Duo was the incantation of a stronger variant of the the spell Ventus. The spell created a stronger jet of spiralling wind than the standard version, which could cause more damage to an opponent in a wizard's duel.

vera-verto.effect: Vera Verto was the incantation of a Transfiguration spell used to transform an animal into a water goblet. Animals susceptible to this spell were specifically aves, rats, and felines.

verdillious.effect: Verdillious was the incantation of a charm that caused the wand tip to light up like a flare, exuding green light, sparks and smoke to damage an opponent.

verdimillious-charm.effect: The Verdimillious Charm (Verdimillious) was a charm that emitted green sparks from the wand. These sparks could be used to reveal objects hidden by Dark Arts and could be used offensively in a duel.

verdimillious-duo-spell.effect: The Verdimillious Duo Spell (Verdimillious) was a charm that emitted green sparks from the tip of the wand. It was a more powerful version of the Verdimillious Charm. It held a number of useful purposes and was rather easy to cast.

vermiculus.effect: Vermiculus was the incantation of a transforming jinx used to transfigure things into worms.

victor-rookwood-s-curse.effect: This curse caused the victim considerable pain, agony, and illness for years afterwards. It could not be cured by any ordinary means, as both healing magic and Shrivelfigs had no impact. It was suggested that it could be cured through a Dark relic, though this was never attempted in practice.

vulnera-sanentur.effect: Vulnera Sanentur was the song-like incantation of a healing spell which healed deep wounds, and could also be used as the counter-curse for the curse Sectumsempra.

wand-extinguishing-charm.effect: The Wand-Extinguishing Charm (Nox) was a charm that caused the light at the end of the caster's wand to be extinguished, thus acting as the counter-charm to the Wand-Lighting Charm (Lumos).

wand-lighting-charm.effect: The Wand-Lighting Charm (Lumos) was a charm that illuminated the tip of the caster's wand, allowing the caster to see in the dark. The counter-charm for the spell was the Wand-Extinguishing Charm (Nox), which was used to extinguish the light from the caster's wand. The charm could be used to reveal magically hidden things.
wand-lighting-charm.effectFr: Fait jaillir un petit faisceau de lumière de l'extrémité de la baguette de l'auteur.

washing-up-spell.effect: This spell enchanted dirty dishes to wash themselves.

water-making-spell.effect: The Water-Making Spell, also known as the Aguamenti Charm or the Water-Conjuring Charm, (Aguamenti) was a charm that conjured a jet of clean, drinkable water from the tip of the caster's wand. This spell, in addition to being a charm, could also be classified as conjuration, an advanced form of Transfiguration.
water-making-spell.effectFr: Sortilège qui fait apparaître une fontaine ou un jet d'eau de la baguette.

weight-loss-charms.effect: Weight-loss charms were charms that reduce the weight of a person. Some weight-loss charms appeared to be "more serious" than others, and allowed wizards to eat high-calorie food all the time.

white-sparks.effect: White sparks was a charm that precipitated a jet of white sparks from the tip of the wand. It could also be used offensively as a minor duelling spell. When these sparks were produced in large quantities, it was difficult to see or breathe when in the vicinity.

windy-spell.effect: The Windy Spell (Ventus) was a charm which shot a jet of strong, spiralling wind from the tip of the wand.

wiping-spell.effect: The Wiping Spell (Tergeo) was the incantation of a cleaning spell used to siphon liquids such as blood, dust or grease, and to clean objects.
wiping-spell.effectFr: Nettoye la cible ; objet ou individu.
